Mean F statistic is {f} (below {thr}): weak instruments bias two-sample estimates toward the null, and MR-Egger and the weighted median and mode more than IVW. F above 10 does not rule out bias either, in particular when the instruments were selected in the same exposure GWAS that gives their effects (winner's curse).
The dIVW condition number, (mean F - 1) x the square root of the number of instruments, is {c} (below {thr}): the normal approximation behind the dIVW interval and P value may be unreliable.
I2GX is {i2} (below {thr}): {bias} (NOME violation). Interpret it with caution.

I2GX is {i2}: at least {lo} but below {thr}. In the MR Studio calibration the radial MR-Egger estimate was diluted toward the null by about 11% in this range (MR-Egger by about 8%), so read it with that in mind.
Cochran's Q P = {p}: the variants disagree more than chance allows, which suggests pleiotropy. The multiplicative random-effects IVW allows for this; compare with the robust methods.
recommend: MR-Egger; weighted median; weighted mode; MR-RAPS; contamination mixture; MR-Lasso; outlier analysis (Instrument review)
